title: Parity-dependent Casimir forces and Hall currents for a confined Dirac field
summary: We study a massless Dirac field subjected to two alternative boundary conditions on two parallel thin walls, in d + 1 dimensions. The two configurations correspond to the system being even or odd under reflection about the midplane between the two walls, and lead to qualitatively different behaviors. The even (symmetric) configuration produces an attractive Casimir force, whereas the odd (antisymmetric) one yields repulsion, in agreement with a general theorem linking parity to the sign of the fermionic Casimir effect.
